title: PIXL 8000 Sour Cherry Apple Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Sour Cherry Apple PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod combines juicy red Apple with a tangy Cherry bite for a punchy, layered fruit vape. The interplay of sweetness and sharpness creates a clean, energising profile that stays bright and refreshing throughout the day. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and connects to a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically refills the pod as you vape—supporting up to 8000 puffs per kit. Mesh coil technology ensures reliable vapour production and consistent flavour, while the MTL draw keeps the experience comfortable and familiar.
